iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

GTP::forward
       Forwards GTP message to peer flow.

SYNOPSIS
       GTP::forward MESSAGE

DESCRIPTION
       Forwards GTP message to peer flow.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when GTP_SIGNALLING_INGRESS {
	    set t2 [GTP::new 2 10]
	    GTP::forward $t2
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
